name: yoycol-mcp
description: Yoycol (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shipping. Every tool maps to a d

platform_mcp_yoycol_access_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YOYCOL_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_yoycol_access_key.description: accessKey issued by Yoycol for OPEN API V4 (sent as X-API-Access-Key).

platform_mcp_yoycol_secret_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YOYCOL_SECRET_KEY
platform_mcp_yoycol_secret_key.description: secretKey issued with it; signs every request (Base64 HMAC-SHA256 over method, path, timestamp, nonce, accessKey, algorithm, version and the sorted query). Never sent on the wire.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists one catalogue product (GET /api/2025/open/v4/catalog/products?page=1&size=1). Auth failures come back as codes 300001-300010 in the body.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Products (Catalog): Yoycol print-on-demand blanks {id, spuCode, name, spuDisplayImg, onlineStatus, variantCount}; `query` is a fuzzy name keyword; `category` is not supported. No prices in the list — use get_product.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get Product with include=variants: product {id, spuCode, name, spuDisplayImg} and variants[{id, skuCode, size, color, weight, salesPrice, currency, onlineStatus}] in `raw`; mapped price/sku are the first variant's. A variant skuCode is what quote_shipping takes.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Get Sku Quotes: `product_id` must be a variant skuCode (from get_product). Returns every shipping region with its logistics levels [{levelCode, levelName, firstPrice, additionalPrice, timeEffectPriority}]; `country` and `quantity` are not inputs of this endpoint — pick the region and compute firstPrice + (quantity-1) x additionalPrice.
